{"metadata":{"description":"Nix-native packaging for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)","id":"gh:1333312916","install_available":false,"language":"Nix","name":"dsh-nix","slug":"Samuka007/dsh-nix","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Nix-native packaging for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-nix"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Nix-native packaging for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`):"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"1. **`pkgs.dsh`** — the CLI as a reproducible Nix package (pnpm monorepo build,

one ordered"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" list, with build-time resolution instead of `dsh plugin`'s
activation-time pnpm reconcile.
3. **`pr"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ograms.dsh` Home Manager module** — declarative plugin management in
the Thunderbird style: the modu"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"le owns the composition under `~/.dsh`,
the app owns its data."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Plugin model"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A profile's `plugins` list accepts three kinds, mixed in any order:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Kind | Example | Resolution |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| in-box bundle | `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-base"` | name only; resolved from the `dsh` installation |

| Nix package/path | `pkgs.fetchFromGitHub { ... }` or `./my-plugin` | symlinked int"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"o the profile; carries its own dependency closure |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Layer registration (which plugins join `dsh.profile.bundles`) is a pure
build-time reconcile that re"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ads each resolved package's `dsh.bundle.patch`
declaration — `dsh plugin`'s install/resolve/reconcil"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e is replaced wholesale,
so removal is declarative and resolution failures surface at `nix build`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"In-box profiles get a **build-time boot check**: `checks.profile-boot-web`
and `checks.profile-boot-"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"headless` boot the composed profile with dsh's own
`boot()` (which runs `assertEntriesActivated`) in"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"side the Nix sandbox and
dispose immediately. A profile that would fail at runtime — missing
service"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"s, failed activation — fails `nix build` instead. The check is the
real dsh fail-loud, not a reimple"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"mentation: `scripts/check-profile.mjs`
loads the profile exactly as `dsh --profile` would and lets d"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"sh's own
audit decide. `checks.profile-boot-web-nobase` proves the check catches a
web-app-without-b"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ase composition (8 pending entries)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Overlay"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The Home Manager module's `package` option defaults to `pkgs.dsh` when the

`~"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"/.dsh` remain the app's."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Standalone"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The package also ships `dsh-acp-demo`, the ACP automation server app
